'''Minori Suzuki''' (Japanese: '''鈴木みのり''' ''Minori Suzuki'') is a Japanese voice actress for {{aniseries|HZ}}.

==Biography==
Suzuki was born in Aichi Prefecture, Japan on Oct 1, 1997. Her voicing acting career started in {{wp|Macross Delta}}, where was chosen out of 8000 people, having previously done no voice acting work. She had her first voicing role in the {{pkmn|animated series}} as [[Regina]] in {{aniseries|JN}}, before eventually getting the major voice acting role of [[Liko]], one of the protagonists of {{aniseries|HZ}}.
